name: NittyGriddy
author: Tim Sonner
description: Window grid for Omarchy. Lists windows on the focused screen and keeps workspace numbers 1-9, even when empty. The number stays visible when a title is long, and the quake console uses the workstation of the screen it is on. Snippets add the swipes and Super+W / Super+Shift+number. Three-finger up opens the grid and down dismisses it. Left and right switch workspaces when the grid is closed, and page the strip when it is open.
